scenes.say: You set permissions to seven fifty five, but your web server still gets a forbidden error. What's going on?

scenes.label: SELinux
scenes.sub: Adds labels to files and ports, blocking mismatches.
scenes.say: SELinux adds a second layer of access control. It uses labels on files and ports. If labels don’t match, access is denied, even if chmod looks right.

scenes.title: Check and fix SELinux issues
scenes.say: To debug, check if SELinux is enforcing. Use ausearch to see what was denied, then restore file labels with restorecon.

scenes.question: App fails in enforcing mode. What now?
scenes.right: Read the denial, then fix the label or port context.
scenes.say: In interviews, never say 'just disable SELinux.' Instead, read the denial and fix the label or port context.
